args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: 0. Cleared: 8 (r01–r08).
Checks: in every run, rigid-body invariance and closure pass. Plane sections passes where it was run (r02, r03, r08). It was not run for the width-free-ratio runs (r01, r04, r05, r06, r07).
Profiles: all runs share the same shape. The centre strain-rate (REGR) peak sits at 421 µm and the growth zone is 674–684 µm in every run.
Large |z| values come from tiny batch MADs, not real differences. The REGR peaks span 51.93–53.28 %/h. The r05/r07 peak gap is 0.12 %/h and their flank-difference shift is on a near-zero profile. r08 peaks 1.2 %/h lower, which reads as a slower root. Its 1105 µm flank-difference position is the maximum of a near-flat 0.61 %/h curvature-rate profile.
Caveat: r08 was registered on tissue from 400 px behind the tip. If that region overlaps the growth zone (peak at 421 µm; the px-to-µm scale isn't given), registration could slightly lower the velocity gradient. It's worth checking the scale.
Nothing was flagged, so the flagged runs have nothing in common to report.
